name: DUMBBELL SINGLE LEG HIP THRUST LEFT
introduce: Sit with your feet flat on the floor. Rest your shoulders on a bench. Put a dumbbell on your left thigh. \n\nLift your right leg, then raise your hips until your left knee is at 90 degrees. Hold for a second, then slowly lower them. Repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Exhale when lifting your hips, and inhale when lowering them.
